//: ETicketsGo background worker (BullMQ hold expiry, notification/webhook/outbox/inventory sweeps + the repeatable scheduled jobs — there is no separate scheduler service; the schedule lives in BullMQ repeatable jobs registered by this process). Root Directory stays '/'. NO preDeployCommand: the API service is the single migration executor, so the worker can never race it. Deploy the worker AFTER the API in a promotion so the schema is already current. Health/readiness are served by the worker's own HTTP listener on PORT (Railway-injected; WORKER_PORT/4100 remain the fallback) — /health is liveness, /ready additionally checks PostgreSQL + Redis, /metrics is the Prometheus endpoint. Railway health checks require the service to listen on PORT; this service is internal-only, so do NOT attach a public domain to it.
